NAME:
   rancher schema - Print the schema manifest, optionally filtered to one command

USAGE:
   rancher schema [options] [command] [subcommand]

OPTIONS:
   --all              print the complete schema manifest in structured output (table output still shows the table of contents)
   --contract string  show only commands with this contract
   --destructive      show only destructive commands, including commands that are destructive only for some inputs (destructive true or dependsOnInput)
   --help, -h         show help
   --kind             treat the argument as a kind name, not a command name
   --mutating         show only mutating commands
   --search string    case-insensitive substring search over command names, aliases, usage, and descriptions
   --verb string      show only commands with this verb (the first word of the command name)

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
